To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Separation risk mitigation plan for Marcus Li — timeline & responsibilities

Team —

This thread is to align on an expedited separation for Marcus Li (ENG). HR flagged an active investigation and leadership authorized an involuntary step pending final sign-off. High level asks:

- HR (Laura): can you confirm severance framework and DOCS we will share? I've attached a draft severance_offer_v1.pdf for review.
- Legal (Karthik): please review the attached language and advise any mandatory hold or non-disclosure clauses before we send.
- Manager (Rishi): confirm critical knowledge capture (on-call, PRs, ongoing tickets) and who covers his components immediately.
- IT (Monica): immediate access revocation plan + equipment retrieval timeline.

Target timeline (subject to legal/HR confirmation):
- 2026-12-13: finalize offer packet and revoke remote tokens after termination call
- 2026-12-14: in-person/offsite meeting; Marcus out same day after meet
- 2026-12-15: equipment pickup and final payroll processing

Please reply with your blocking concerns or "ack" if you can take the indicated item. If you need a short sync, I can set one up this afternoon.

Neha Kapoor
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Separation risk mitigation plan for Marcus Li — timeline & responsibilities

Neha — thanks for kicking this off. I reviewed the attached severance draft and added standard language for IP assignment and a one-week continuation of benefits. See comments in severance_offer_v1.pdf. A couple notes:

- We should offer 8 weeks pay + accelerated equity vest for this role level as a baseline; I'm open to adjusting depending on legal risk.
- I recommend we include a short neutral reference template and an explicit non-disparagement clause.
- I'll own the employee-facing communications and the DocuSign flow.

I'll circulate a redlined packet by EOD. Marking this high priority — please do not send anything externally until Karthik signs off.

Laura Bennett
VP, People & Talent
Redwood Inference
Attachment: severance_offer_v1.pdf (redlines expected)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-11T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Separation risk mitigation plan for Marcus Li — timeline & responsibilities

Laura/Neha — I reviewed the draft. A few legal flags:

1) Investigation still has outstanding witness statements; we need a clause preserving company right to adjust terms if misconduct findings change within 30 days.
2) Do not include language that could be construed as waiving claims related to safety or criminal acts.
3) Suggested minor edits to the NDAs and IP assignment — I attached a redline.

Request: delay any outbound communication for 48 hours after we finalize language. Also ask IT to preserve disk images and Slack exports under legal hold until we confirm. Monica, can you queue the preservation requests?

Karthik Iyer
General Counsel
Redwood Inference
Attachment: legal_redline_severance.docx

- On-call: I will reassign Marcus's pager to Priya N. and brief her on the runbook tonight.

- Knowledge capture: I've exported Marcus's open design doc and created a short hand-off doc in the shared folder (link below). Suggest Marcus provide a final list of critical tickets during the meeting.

On communications, I agree with Karthik — hold public comms until legal signs off. For the team, I plan a brief private meeting tomorrow morning to address questions and minimize speculation.

All — update from IT ops: preservation and offboard plan is ready. Actions I'll take on 2026-12-15 after HR/Legal confirmation: 

1) Place hold on Marcus's Google account and export Slack/drive contents to the legal bucket (kb-handbook-export.zip).
2) Revoke all active tokens (API keys, SSH certs) at termination call complete.
3) Coordinate equipment pickup: vendor will pick up laptop and badge between 12/16-12/18; I'll provide chain-of-custody form.
4) Run quick audit for privileged access and remove any service accounts by EOD 12/15.

I've attached the IT checklist (it_offboard_checklist.xlsx) and will confirm when exports are completed. Once Karthik confirms legal hold wording, I'm ready to proceed.

Monica Patel
Director, IT Operations
